records.title: Operations in FIR Minsk (UMMV)
records.statusAtReview: published; EASA Safety Publications Tool lists no supersedure
applicability: EASA Member State national competent authorities responsible for oversight of aircraft operators under Commission Regulation (EU) 965/2012
EASA Member State national competent authorities responsible for oversight of air navigation service providers under Commission Regulation (EU) 2017/373
records.ncaCorrectiveAction: National competent authorities should ensure aircraft operators having their principal place of business in their territory do not conduct operations in FIR Minsk (UMMV), unless use of that airspace is deemed necessary to ensure safe operation in case of unforeseen circumstances.
records.exception: Use of FIR Minsk may be necessary to ensure safe operation in case of unforeseen circumstances.
